correctness.rationale: The homomorphic image of a local rule onto S3 must have exactly one automorphism-bearing site, as proper homomorphic images of S3 are abelian and S3 has trivial center. The C2 coordinate is determined by sign and binary coefficients. The quotient is an automorphism-shift; dual Laurent multiplication proves that the central map is onto exactly when P is nonzero and is invertible exactly when P is a monomial. Bowen entropy addition and the cited one-dimensional scalar Laurent-entropy theorem yield the displayed formula. Independent group-presentation enumeration of 64 endomorphisms, 144 globally onto two-site rules, 96 reversible two-site rules, 168 onto two-site local maps, and coefficients through seven sites corroborates the proof; general statements do not depend on finite tests.

value.rationale: The first dihedral group with a nontrivial central C2 direct factor and nonabelian quotient provides a natural setting where global versus merely local surjectivity diverge. The complete census gives the exact 6r(2^r-2) false-positive gap, the exact proportion r/(2^r-1) of reversible onto rules, and all r^2 distinguished entropy values with multiplicities. These quantify how central coupling creates noninvertibility while leaving entropy invariant, providing a finite-alphabet benchmark for general entropy-decomposition methods.
